subject: English
question_text: The pic-chart below shows Sakib's time spending on
stimulus: various activities. Describe the chart in 150 words. You should highhight and summars the information given in the chart. 10
guide_solution: Graph & charts This is a pie chart of Rahim's daily activities. It shows what he does and how much time he spends in each field. Sakib is a very organized student. He is very hard working. He does not like to sleep a lot. For sleeping he has a fixed time. He spends only 25% time in sleeping. Sakib is a serious student. He is very careful of his study. He goes to school everyday and studies at home regularly. The time he stays in the school is 25%. He likes game and sports. He plays quite a good amount of time daily. 20% of the total time is spent in playing. The chart says that he is very quick in taking meals. He needs only 5% time for taking food. He does not want to break the schedule. So he has also a fixed time for other activities. He does home work everyday for which he spends 10% time. And, he enjoys entertaining programme for which he spends 18% time. In fact, the graph shows that he is a very methodical student. His allocation of time for performing daily activities is quite practical.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 91 — Noakhali Zilla School
